generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In the test method `create_belowMaxConcurrency_fatalErrorPreventsReuse`, the line `listener.onClose(Status.fromThrowable(mock(Errors.NativeIoException.class)), new Metadata());` is redundant and potentially misleading. It calls `onClose` on the inner dummy listener rather than the wrapper listener created inside `SharedConnection`. The test only passes because the mock setup for `call.start(...)` already triggers `onClose` on the wrapper. This line should be removed to avoid confusion about how the fatal error is actually triggered.

review_comment: This is more of a whitebox test than I would have liked, but I didn't find another way to simulate a connection failure. Open to suggestions here to make this more realistic.
